Bear in mind that last year athletes of the calibre of Kevin Young, Florian Schwarthoff and Francis Obikwelu were competing for their European Clubs in Division II and you'll realise that a feast of athletics is in store with your club in the thick of it.

Sporting Club of Portugal had a number of overseas members including former World Junior Sprint Champion Francis Obikwelu. Somehow, Panellinios of Greece had obtained the services of 400H World Record Holder Kevin Young.
